info.title: NHTSA vPIC Universal API
info.description: Decode VINs and browse NHTSA vehicle makes, models, and manufacturers

get.description: Decodes a VIN with NHTSA vPIC.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: modelYear
parameters.description: Optional model year used to improve VIN decoding accuracy, especially for partial VINs.

schema.description: Optional model year used to improve VIN decoding accuracy, especially for partial VINs.

parameters.name: vin
parameters.description: Vehicle Identification Number to decode. Partial VINs are supported with a * placeholder.

schema.description: Vehicle Identification Number to decode. Partial VINs are supported with a * placeholder.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
